Update the eufy app to the latest version (Android 4.9.3_4359, iOS 4.9.35_1651) to get the full performance of the camera.
Capture every detail day or night in 4K, and talk to family or pets through the built-in two-way audio.
Quick Focus Tap and Panoramic View in the app let you switch the camera's focus instantly by tapping the area you want to see.
On-device AI tells people, pets, audio cues and crying apart, and the camera follows a person or pet automatically once it is detected.
The built-in spotlight switches between color and infrared night vision for clear night footage, and also works as a deterrent.
Works with HomeKit, Alexa and Google Assistant. HomeKit streams at up to 1080P resolution.
Store footage locally on an SD card (sold separately) and use every feature without a subscription. Cloud storage is available as an option.
